rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn ʿĀmir opens tāʾ in yā abat throughout the Quran; the others kasra it. Ibn Kathīr pauses on hāʾ, while the rest pause on tāʾ.
rows.anchor: 1 اختلفوا فى كسر التاء وفتحها من قوله ﴿ يا أبت إني رأيت ﴾ 4

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Kisāʾī generally applies imāla to raʾyāk and related forms; Abū al-Ḥārith reports an exception at lā taqṣuṣ ruʾyāk, while al-Dūrī reports no exception. Ḥamza and the others open the vowels.
rows.anchor: 2 - قوله ﴿ لا تقصص رؤياك ﴾ 5

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr alone reads āya li-l-sāʾilīn in the singular; all other readers use the plural āyāt.
rows.anchor: 3 واختلفوا فى الجمع والتوحيد من قوله ﴿ آيات للسائلين ﴾ 7

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, and al-Kisāʾī use ḍamma on the tanwīn in مبين اقتلوا; ʿĀṣim, Abū ʿAmr, Ibn ʿĀmir, and Ḥamza use kasra.
rows.anchor: 4 قوله ﴿ مبين اقتلوا ﴾ 8 9

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nāfiʿ alone reads ghiyābat al-jubb in the plural; the others read it in the singular.
rows.anchor: 5 واختلفوا فى التوحيد والجمع من قوله ﴿ في غيابة الجب ﴾ 10

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All readers open the mīm, assimilate the first nūn into the second, and indicate ḍamma on the merged nūn in taʾmannā.
rows.anchor: 6 قوله ﴿ لا تأمنا ﴾ 11

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr reads nartaʿ with nūn and kasra on ʿayn; a report gives yalʿab with yāʾ and jazm. Nāfiʿ uses yāʾ in yartaʿ and yalʿab, while retaining the kasra and jazm endings.
rows.anchor: 7 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ يرتع ويلعب ﴾ 12

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abū ʿAmr and Ibn ʿĀmir use nūn in both verbs with both endings quiescent; ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use yāʾ in both with jazm.
rows.anchor: وقرأ أبو عمرو وابن عامر / نرتع ونلعب / بالنون فيهما وتسكين العين والباء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most named readers hamzate al-dhiʾb; al-Kisāʾī, some reports from Abū ʿAmr, and a Warsh transmission from Nāfiʿ omit hamza. Abū Bakr rejects Ibn Jammāz's claim that Nāfiʿ omits it as mistaken.
rows.anchor: 8 واختلفوا فى همز ﴿ الذئب ﴾ 14 وتركه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, and Ibn ʿĀmir open yāʾ and retain alif in yā bushrā; ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use the alif form without yāʾ. Warsh reports quiescent yāʾ in related forms; ʿĀṣim opens rāʾ while Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī apply imāla.
rows.anchor: 9 واختلفوا فى فتح الياء وإثبات الألف وإسكانها وإسقاط الألف من قوله ﴿ يا بشرى هذا ﴾ 19

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr reads hayta with fatḥa on hāʾ, quiescent yāʾ, and ḍamma on tāʾ; Nāfiʿ and Ibn ʿĀmir use kasra on hāʾ and fatḥa on tāʾ.
rows.anchor: 10 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ هيت لك ﴾ 23

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hishām reports Ibn ʿĀmir's hamzated hayʾtu with ḍamma on tāʾ; al-Ḥulwānī reports fatḥa on tāʾ. Ibn Dhakwān has no stated hamza report. ʿĀṣim, Abū ʿAmr, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use the unhamzated fatḥa form.
rows.anchor: وروى هشام بن عمار بأسناده عن ابن عامر / هئت لك / من تهيأت لك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Abū ʿAmr, and Ibn ʿĀmir kasra lām in al-mukhliṣīn here and mukhliṣan at 19:51; Nāfiʿ follows only at 19:51. ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī generally use fatḥa, while everyone kasras forms tied to dīn.
rows.anchor: 11 واختلفوا فى فتح اللام وكسرها من قوله ﴿ إنه من عبادنا المخلصين ﴾ 24

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, al-Kisāʾī, Nāfiʿ, and Ibn ʿĀmir have ḍamma on tāʾ in qālat ukhruj, though Nāfiʿ's transmitters differ; Abū ʿAmr, ʿĀṣim, and Ḥamza use kasra.
rows.anchor: 12 قوله ﴿ وقالت اخرج ﴾ 31

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abū ʿAmr reads ḥāshā li-llāh with alif; the others use the form without alif. A report from al-Aṣmaʿī also gives Nāfiʿ the alif form.
rows.anchor: 13 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ حاش لله ﴾ 31 51

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The listed readers quiesce the hamza in dʾaban; Abū ʿAmr drops hamza when reading in connected flow.
rows.anchor: 14 واختلفوا فى إسكان الهمزة وتحريكها وإسقاطها من قوله ﴿ دأبا ﴾ 47

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn ʿĀmir and ʿĀṣim in the Abū Bakr and Ḥafṣ transmissions read fanunji with doubled jīm, fatḥa on yāʾ, and one passive nūn; another chain confirms one nūn. Hubayra's two-nūn report is called an error.
rows.anchor: وقرأ ابن عامر وعاصم فى رواية أبى بكر وحفص ﴿ فنجي من نشاء ﴾ مشددة الجيم مفتوحة الياء بنون واحدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abū ʿAmr alone uses yāʾ in ألا يتخذوا; the others use tāʾ in ألا تتخذوا.
rows.anchor: 1 اختلفوا فى الياء والتاء من قوله ﴿ ألا تتخذوا من دوني وكيلا ﴾ 2

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, and Ḥafṣ read the plural yāʾ form; Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim, Ibn ʿĀmir, and Ḥamza use singular yāʾ, while al-Kisāʾī uses nūn.
rows.anchor: 2 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ ليسوؤوا وجوهكم ﴾ 7

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn ʿĀmir reads yulqīhi with ḍamma yāʾ and doubled qāf; the others use yalqīhi with fatḥa yāʾ, quiescent lām, and light qāf. Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī apply imāla to qāf.
rows.anchor: 3 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ ونخرج له يوم القيامة كتابا يلقاه ﴾ 13

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The default reading of amarnā has light mīm and short alif; reports give lengthening from Khārija via Nāfiʿ and Ibn Kathīr, and doubled mīm from Abū ʿAmr.
rows.anchor: 4 قوله ﴿ أمرنا مترفيها ﴾ 16

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, ʿĀṣim, and Ibn ʿĀmir use singular yablughanna; Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī use dual. In uff, Ibn Kathīr and Ibn ʿĀmir use fatḥa, Nāfiʿ and Ḥafṣ tanwīn, and several others kasra without tanwīn.
rows.anchor: 5 واختلفوا فى التوحيد والتثنية من قوله ﴿ إما يبلغن عندك ﴾ 23

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For uff, Ibn Kathīr and Ibn ʿĀmir use fatḥa on fāʾ; Nāfiʿ and Ḥafṣ use tanwīn; Abū ʿAmr, Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use kasra without tanwīn.
rows.anchor: 6 واختلفوا فى فتح الفاء وكسرها والتنوين من قوله ﴿ فلا تقل لهما أف ﴾ 23

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr's main form is long and hamzated with kasra on khāʾ; Ibn ʿĀmir has fatḥa on khāʾ and ṭāʾ, while Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use the short hamzated form. A report gives Ibn Kathīr the latter.
rows.anchor: 7 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ كان خطأ كبيرا ﴾ 31

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, and ʿĀṣim use yāʾ in fa-lā yasrif; Ḥamza, al-Kisāʾī, and Ibn ʿĀmir use tāʾ. Both are jussive.
rows.anchor: 8 واختلفوا فى الياء والتاء من قوله ﴿ فلا يسرف في القتل ﴾ 33

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most readers, including Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim, use ḍamma on qāf in al-qisṭās; Ḥamza, al-Kisāʾī, and Ḥafṣ use kasra at both al-Isrāʾ and al-Shuʿarāʾ 26:182.
rows.anchor: 9 واختلفوا فى ضم القاف وكسرها من قوله ﴿ بالقسطاس ﴾ 35

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, and Abū ʿAmr read sayyiʾa as feminine and unannexed; ʿĀṣim, Ibn ʿĀmir, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī read it as masculine and annexed.
rows.anchor: 10 واختلفوا فى الإضافة والتنوين من قوله ﴿ كان سيئه عند ربك ﴾ 38

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, ʿĀṣim, and Ibn ʿĀmir double dhāl in li-yadhdhakkarū; Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī lighten it, also at al-Furqān 25:50.
rows.anchor: 11 واختلفوا فى تشديد الذال وتخفيفها من قوله ﴿ ليذكروا ﴾ 41

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Readers vary between yāʾ and tāʾ in the three forms: Ibn Kathīr uses yāʾ throughout; Nāfiʿ, Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim, and Ibn ʿĀmir use tāʾ only at 17:42; further groupings continue in the next segment.
rows.anchor: 12 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ لو كان معه آلهة كما يقولون إذا لابتغوا إلى ذي العرش سبيلا ﴾ 42

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abū ʿAmr uses tāʾ, yāʾ, tāʾ across the three forms; Ḥafṣ uses yāʾ in the first two and tāʾ in the third; Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī use tāʾ throughout.
rows.anchor: وقرأ أبو عمرو / ءالهة كما تقولون / بالتاء و ﴿ عما يقولون ﴾ بالياء ﴿ تسبح له ﴾ بالتاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The readers differ in interrogative hamza patterns for aʾidhā and aʾinnā: Ibn Kathīr uses hamza then quiescent yāʾ without lengthening; Nāfiʿ treats the second as declarative; ʿĀṣim and Ḥamza use two hamzas; Ibn ʿĀmir has no question in the first; Abū ʿAmr lengthens both.
rows.anchor: 13 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ وقالوا أئذا كنا عظاما ورفاتا أئنا لمبعوثون ﴾ 49

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḥamza alone reads zabūran with ḍamma on zāy; the others use fatḥa.
rows.anchor: 14 قوله ﴿ وآتينا داود زبورا ﴾ 55

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, and Abū ʿAmr retain yāʾ in connection; Ibn Kathīr also retains it at pause. Ibn ʿĀmir, ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī omit it in both positions.
rows.anchor: 15 قوله ﴿ لئن أخرتن إلى يوم القيامة ﴾ 62

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḥafṣ from ʿĀṣim kasras the jīm in rajlika; Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim and all other readers quiesce it.
rows.anchor: 16 قوله ﴿ وأجلب عليهم بخيلك ورجلك ﴾ 64

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The other readers quiesce the jīm in rajlika, matching Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim.
rows.anchor: وكذلك قرأ الباقون ﴿ ورجلك ﴾ ساكنة الجيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr and Abū ʿAmr use nūn throughout the verbs in both verses; Nāfiʿ, ʿĀṣim, Ibn ʿĀmir, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use yāʾ.
rows.anchor: 17 واختلفوا فى الياء والنون من قوله ﴿ أفأمنتم أن يخسف بكم جانب البر أو يرسل عليكم حاصبا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, and Ibn ʿĀmir open mīm in both aʿmā forms; Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī kasra both; Abū ʿAmr kasras the first and opens the second. Ḥafṣ does not kasra either.
rows.anchor: 18 واختلفوا فى فتح الميم وكسرها من قوله ﴿ ومن كان في هذه أعمى فهو في الآخرة أعمى ﴾ 72

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The readers differ in the form of khalafaka: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, and Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim share one form; Ḥafṣ and Ibn ʿĀmir, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī are separately reported.
rows.anchor: 19 واختلفوا فى كسر الخاء وإثبات الألف من قوله ﴿ خلفك ﴾ 76

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The readings of wa-naʾā differ in vowel quality and length: Ibn Kathīr and Nāfiʿ open, Ibn ʿĀmir lengthens, al-Kisāʾī and Ḥamza transmissions vary, and ʿĀṣim and Abū ʿAmr reports differ between this verse and al-Sajda 32:51.
rows.anchor: 20 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ ونأى بجانبه ﴾ 83

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, and Ibn ʿĀmir read tafajjara with ḍamma tāʾ, fatḥa fāʾ, and doubled jīm; ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use fatḥa tāʾ, quiescent fāʾ, and light jīm.
rows.anchor: 21 واختلفوا فى فتح التاء والتخفيف وضمها والتشديد من قوله ﴿ حتى تفجر لنا من الأرض ينبوعا ﴾ 90

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The readers differ between vocalized and quiescent sīn in kisfan across Quranic occurrences: Ibn Kathīr, Abū ʿAmr, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī quiesce it except at al-Rūm; Nāfiʿ, ʿĀṣim transmissions, and Ibn ʿĀmir have other patterns.
rows.anchor: 22 واختلفوا فى فتح السين وإسكانها من قوله ﴿ كسفا ﴾ 92

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr and Ibn ʿĀmir read qāla subḥāna rabbī with alif, as in Meccan and Syrian codices; Nāfiʿ, ʿĀṣim, Abū ʿAmr, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī omit it.
rows.anchor: 23 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ قل سبحان ربي ﴾ 93 فى ضم القاف وإسقاط الألف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Kisāʾī alone uses ḍamma on tāʾ in ʿalimta; the other readers use fatḥa.
rows.anchor: 24 واختلفوا فى ضم التاء وفتحها من قوله ﴿ لقد علمت ﴾ 2 1

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abū ʿAmr transmitters differ over the vowels on lām and wāw; ʿĀṣim and Ḥamza use kasra on both.
rows.anchor: 25 قوله ﴿ قل ادعوا الله أو ادعوا الرحمن ﴾ 110

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Of fifteen yāʾs of addition in this sura, only rabbī in خزائن رحمة ربي إذا differs: Abū ʿAmr and Nāfiʿ open it, while the others quiesce it.
rows.anchor: فى هذه السورة خمس عشرة ياء إضافة اختلفوا فى واحدة ﴿ خزائن رحمة ربي إذا ﴾ 100

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For the additional yāʾ in akhkhartan, Ibn Kathīr connects and pauses with it; Nāfiʿ and Abū ʿAmr connect with it but pause without; ʿĀṣim, Ibn ʿĀmir, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī omit it throughout.
rows.anchor: قال أبو بكر حذف من هذه السورة ياءان إحداهما ياء إضافة والأخرى لام الفعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In al-muhtad, the yāʾ is a verb ending: the people of Medina and Abū ʿAmr connect with it but pause without; Ibn Kathīr and Kūfan and Syrian readers omit it in both positions.
rows.anchor: وقوله ﴿ فهو المهتد ﴾ 97 الياء منها لام الفعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim alone reads min ladunhī with ḍamma-signaled dāl, kasra on nūn and hāʾ, and a yāʾ after hāʾ in connection; the others, including Ḥafṣ, use the standard vocalization without extending hāʾ to wāw.
rows.anchor: 1 قوله ﴿ من لدنه ﴾ 2

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Abū ʿAmr, ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī kasra mīm and open fāʾ in mirfaq; Nāfiʿ and Ibn ʿĀmir open mīm and kasra fāʾ, also reported from al-Kisāʾī via Abū Bakr.
rows.anchor: 2 واختلفوا فى فتح الميم وكسر الفاء وكسر الميم وفتح الفاء من قوله ﴿ مرفقا ﴾ 16

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, and Abū ʿAmr double zāy in tazāwar; ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī lighten it; Ibn ʿĀmir reads it like taḥmar.
rows.anchor: 3 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ تزاور عن كهفهم ﴾ 17

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr and Nāfiʿ use the doubled, hamzated form of wa-lamulliʾat; ʿĀṣim, Ibn ʿĀmir, Abū ʿAmr, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī lighten it, as one Ibn Kathīr transmission also does.
rows.anchor: 4 واختلفوا فى تشديد اللام وتخفيفها من قوله ﴿ ولملئت منهم رعبا ﴾ 18

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Ibn ʿĀmir, al-Kisāʾī, and Ḥafṣ kasra rāʾ in bi-wariqikum; Abū ʿAmr, Ḥamza, and Abū Bakr quiesce it. A report describes Abū ʿAmr's form as assimilated.
rows.anchor: 5 واختلفوا فى كسر الراء وإسكانها من قوله ﴿ بورقكم ﴾ 19

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, and Abū ʿAmr retain yāʾ in yahdinī in connected recitation; Ibn ʿĀmir, ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī omit it.
rows.anchor: 6 قوله ﴿ عسى أن يهدين ربي ﴾ 24

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr retains the listed yāʾs in connection and pause; Nāfiʿ and Abū ʿAmr retain them only in connection, and al-Kisāʾī retains yāʾ in nabghi alone in connection. Ibn ʿĀmir, ʿĀṣim, and Ḥamza omit them.
rows.anchor: ابن كثير يثبت الياء فيها جميعا فى الوصل والوقف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most named readers use tāʾ in wa-lam takun lahu fiʾa; Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī use yāʾ, and the author marks Ibn ʿĀmir's attribution as uncertain.
rows.anchor: 14 واختلفوا فى التاء والياء من قوله ﴿ ولم تكن له فئة ﴾ 43

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Ibn ʿĀmir, and ʿĀṣim open wāw in al-walāya and use genitive al-ḥaqq; Ḥamza kasras wāw and qāf; Abū ʿAmr opens wāw and uses ḍamma on qāf; ʿAlī b. Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī kasra wāw and use ḍamma on qāf.
rows.anchor: 15 واختلفوا فى قوله ( هنالك الولية لله الحق ) 44

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, Ibn ʿĀmir, and al-Kisāʾī use ḍamma on qāf in ʿuqban; ʿĀṣim and Ḥamza quiesce it and lighten the form.
rows.anchor: 16 واختلفوا فى التثقيل والتخفيف من قوله ﴿ وخير عقبا ﴾ 44

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Abū ʿAmr, and Ibn ʿĀmir use tāʾ in yawm tusayyaru and nominative al-jibāl; Nāfiʿ, ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use nūn and accusative.
rows.anchor: 17 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ ويوم نسير الجبال ﴾ 47

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḥamza alone reads yawm naqūlu with nūn; the other readers use yāʾ.
rows.anchor: 18 واختلفوا فى الياء والنون من قوله ﴿ ويوم يقول نادوا ﴾ 52

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Abū ʿAmr, Nāfiʿ, and Ibn ʿĀmir read qibalan with kasra qāf and fatḥa bāʾ; ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use ḍamma on both.
rows.anchor: 19 واختلفوا فى ضم القاف والباء وكسر القاف وفتح الباء من قوله ﴿ أو يأتيهم العذاب قبلا ﴾ 55

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use ḍamma on both qāf and bāʾ in qibulan.
rows.anchor: وقرأ عاصم وحمزة والكسائى ﴿ قبلا ﴾ بضم القاف والباء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim opens mīm and the second lām in lamahlikihim and mahlik ahlihi; Ḥafṣ kasras lām in both; the others use ḍamma mīm and fatḥa lām.
rows.anchor: 20 قوله ﴿ وجعلنا لمهلكهم موعدا ﴾ 59

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Kisāʾī alone applies imāla to the sīn in wa-mā ansānīhi. Ḥafṣ uses ḍamma on hāʾ here and at 48:10, Abū Bakr uses kasra, and Ibn Kathīr retains yāʾ after hāʾ in connection.
rows.anchor: 21 قوله ﴿ وما أنسانيه إلا الشيطان ﴾ 63

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use ḍamma rāʾ and quiescent shīn in rushdan; Ibn ʿĀmir's reports vary between a heavy and light form, and Abū ʿAmr opens both vowels.
rows.anchor: 22 واختلفوا فى التخفيف والتثقيل من قوله ﴿ مما علمت رشدا ﴾ 66

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Abū ʿAmr, ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī quiesce lām in fa-lā tasʾalnī; Nāfiʿ doubles nūn; Ibn ʿĀmir has a no-yāʾ form, with another Hishām transmission doubling nūn.
rows.anchor: 23 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ فلا تسألني عن شيء ﴾ 70

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The source introduces a disagreement in person and case for li-tughriqa ahlahā; its reader groups continue in the next segment.
rows.anchor: 24 واختلفوا فى التاء والياء ورفع الأهل ونصبهم من قوله ﴿ لتغرق أهلها ﴾ 71

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Abū ʿAmr, Nāfiʿ, Ibn ʿĀmir, and ʿĀṣim use tāʾ and accusative ahlahā; Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī use yāʾ and nominative ahluhā.
rows.anchor: فقرأ ابن كثير وأبو عمرو ونافع وابن عامر وعاصم ﴿ لتغرق أهلها ﴾ بالتاء ﴿ أهلها ﴾ نصبا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, and Abū ʿAmr use zākiya with alif; ʿĀṣim, Ibn ʿĀmir, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use zakiyya without alif and with shadda.
rows.anchor: 25 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ أقتلت نفسا زكية ﴾ 74

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Abū ʿAmr, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī lighten nukran except at 54:6, where Ibn Kathīr also lightens; Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim and Ibn ʿĀmir use heavy forms. Ḥafṣ and Nāfiʿ have variant transmissions.
rows.anchor: 26 واختلفوا فى التخفيف والتثقيل من قوله ﴿ نكرا ﴾ 74 87

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Abū ʿAmr, Ibn ʿĀmir, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use heavy laddunī; Nāfiʿ lightens nūn with ḍamma dāl; Abū Bakr transmissions vary, and the author rejects one ḍamma-lām report as an error. Ḥafṣ follows Abū ʿAmr and Ḥamza.
rows.anchor: 27 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ قد بلغت من لدني عذرا ﴾ 76

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr and Abū ʿAmr kasra khāʾ in li-takhidhta; Abū ʿAmr assimilates dhāl, Ibn Kathīr pronounces it clearly. Nāfiʿ, ʿĀṣim, Ibn ʿĀmir, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī assimilate except Ḥafṣ.
rows.anchor: 28 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ لاتخذت عليه أجرا ﴾ 77

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr and Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim lighten the four cited forms; Nāfiʿ and Abū ʿAmr double them throughout; Ibn ʿĀmir, Ḥamza, al-Kisāʾī, and Ḥafṣ lighten all except the heavy form at al-Nūr 24:55.
rows.anchor: 29 واختلفوا فى التخفيف والتشديد من قوله ﴿ أن يبدلهما ربهما ﴾ 81

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī quiesce ḥāʾ in raḥman; Ibn ʿĀmir uses the heavy form. Abū ʿAmr is reported with both, and transmitters permit either vocalization.
rows.anchor: 30 واختلفوا فى التخفيف والتثقيل من قوله ﴿ وأقرب رحما ﴾ 81

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, and Abū ʿAmr double tāʾ in the three follow-sabab forms; they hamzate other cited forms and double tāʾ in واتبع الذين ظلموا. Further reader groups continue next segment.
rows.anchor: 31 واختلفوا فى تشديد التاء وتخفيفها من قوله ﴿ فأتبع سببا ﴾ 85

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḥusayn al-Juʿfī reports Abū ʿAmr reading واتبع الذين ظلموا; ʿĀṣim, Ibn ʿĀmir, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use cut forms for the other verbs and join this one alone.
rows.anchor: وروى حسين الجعفى عن أبى عمرو ﴿ واتبع الذين ظلموا ﴾ رواه هرون عن حسين عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, and Ḥafṣ read ḥamiʾa with hamza and no alif; Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim, Ibn ʿĀmir, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use ḥamiya with alif and no hamza.
rows.anchor: 32 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ في عين حمئة ﴾ 86

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim, Ibn ʿĀmir, and Abū ʿAmr read jazāʾ al-ḥusnā annexed and nominative; Ḥamza, al-Kisāʾī, and Ḥafṣ use tanwīn and accusative.
rows.anchor: 33 واختلفوا فى الإضافة والتنوين من قوله ﴿ فله جزاء الحسنى ﴾ 88

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr and Abū ʿAmr open sīn at both barrier forms but use ḍamma at Yā-Sīn 36:9; Nāfiʿ, Abū Bakr, and Ibn ʿĀmir use ḍamma throughout; Ḥafṣ reports a different pattern; Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī vary by location.
rows.anchor: 34 واختلفوا فى ضم السين وفتحها من قوله ﴿ بين السدين ﴾ 93 ﴿ وبينهم سدا ﴾ 94

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, ʿĀṣim, and Ibn ʿĀmir use fatḥa on yāʾ in yafqahūna; Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī use ḍamma.
rows.anchor: 35 واختلفوا فى فتح الياء وضمها من قوله ﴿ يفقهون قولا ﴾ 93

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿĀṣim alone hamzates Yaʾjūj and Maʾjūj here and at 21:96; the others omit hamza at both locations.
rows.anchor: 36 واختلفوا فى همز ﴿ يأجوج ومأجوج ﴾ 94

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, ʿĀṣim, and Abū ʿAmr omit alif in kharjan here and at 23:72 but retain it in fa-kharāju rabbik; Ibn ʿĀmir omits it in all three; Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī use it throughout.
rows.anchor: 37 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ فهل نجعل لك خرجا ﴾ 94 وقوله فى المؤمنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr alone reads mā makkannanī with two nūns, as in Meccan codices; the others assimilate the form.
rows.anchor: 38 قوله ﴿ ما مكني فيه ﴾ 95

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most readers lengthen ātūnī after rدمًا; Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim has reports of short iʾtūnī, construed as jiʾūnī, bring me. Ḥafṣ reads the long form like Abū ʿAmr.
rows.anchor: 39 قوله ﴿ ردما آتوني ﴾ 95 96

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Abū ʿAmr, and Ibn ʿĀmir use ḍamma on both ṣād and dāl in al-ṣadafayn; Nāfiʿ, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī open both; Abū Bakr uses ḍamma ṣād and quiescent dāl; Ḥafṣ opens both.
rows.anchor: 40 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ بين الصدفين ﴾ 96

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, Ibn ʿĀmir, and al-Kisāʾī lengthen ātūnī; Abū Bakr and Ḥamza shorten it, though another Abū Bakr report and Ḥafṣ lengthen it.
rows.anchor: 41 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ آتوني أفرغ ﴾ 96

rows.speaker: حفص عن عاصم
rows.claim: Ḥafṣ from ʿĀṣim lengthens ātūnī.
rows.anchor: وحفص عن عاصم / ءاتونى / ممدودة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All readers except Ḥamza lighten ṭāʾ in fa-mā isṭāʿū; Ḥamza doubles it by assimilation. Ibn Mujāhid rejects that form as impermissibly combining two quiescent consonants.
rows.anchor: 42 قوله ﴿ فما اسطاعوا ﴾ 97

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, and Ibn ʿĀmir read dakkan indefinite, unhamzated, and short; Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī use long hamzated dakāʾ without tanwīn. Ḥafṣ transmissions differ.
rows.anchor: 43 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ جعله دكاء ﴾ 98

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, Ibn ʿĀmir, and ʿĀṣim use tāʾ in tanfada; Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī use yāʾ in yanfada.
rows.anchor: 44 واختلفوا فى الياء والتاء من قوله ﴿ قبل أن تنفد كلمات ربي ﴾ 109

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Of 37 additional yāʾs in the sura, nine differ: Nāfiʿ opens all listed forms except the three maʿī ṣabran; Abū ʿAmr quiesces that trio and satجدني; Ibn Kathīr follows him except min dūnī awliyāʾ; Ḥafṣ opens the trio.
rows.anchor: فى هذه السورة سبع وثلاثون ياء إضافة اختلفوا فى تسع منها قوله ﴿ ربي أعلم ﴾

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For al-muhtad, the yāʾ is a verb ending: Nāfiʿ and Abū ʿAmr connect with it and pause without; the others omit it in both positions.
rows.anchor: وحذف من هذه السورة ست ياءات اكتفاء بكسر ما قبلها عنها قوله ﴿ فهو المهتد ﴾ 17

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The readers differ in vowels and assimilation in kāf-hā-yā-ʿayn-ṣād: Ibn Kathīr opens hāʾ/yāʾ and distinguishes dāl; Abū ʿAmr kasras hāʾ, opens yāʾ, and assimilates; Nāfiʿ reports vary; Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim and al-Kisāʾī kasra both; Ḥamza and Ibn ʿĀmir open hāʾ and kasra yāʾ with assimilation.
rows.anchor: 1 اختلفوا فى ﴿ كهيعص ذكر ﴾ 1 2

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr via Qunbul hamzates and lengthens min warāʾī with fatḥa yāʾ; another report from Ibn Kathīr omits hamza and opens yāʾ; the others hamzate and lengthen with quiescent yāʾ.
rows.anchor: 2 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ من ورائي ﴾ 5

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, ʿĀṣim, Ibn ʿĀmir, and Ḥamza use nominative endings in both yarithunī and yarith; Abū ʿAmr and al-Kisāʾī use jussive endings.
rows.anchor: 3 واختلفوا فى الجزم والرفع من قوله ﴿ يرثني ويرث ﴾ 6

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, Ibn ʿĀmir, and Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim use ḍamma on the initial letters of the four listed forms; the other transmissions continue next segment.
rows.anchor: 4 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ عتيا ﴾ 8 و ﴿ وبكيا ﴾ 58

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī kasra initial vowels in all four forms; Ḥafṣ does so except he uses ḍamma in bukiyyan.
rows.anchor: وقرأ حمزة والكسائى بكسر أوائل هذه الحروف كلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most readers use khalaqtuka with tāʾ and no alif; Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī read khalaqnaka with nūn and alif.
rows.anchor: 5 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ وقد خلقتك من قبل ﴾ 9

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, ʿĀṣim, Ibn ʿĀmir, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī hamzate la-ahaba; Abū ʿAmr and Warsh and al-Ḥalwānī from Qālūn omit hamza, while other Nāfiʿ transmitters hamzate.
rows.anchor: 6 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ لأهب لك ﴾ 19

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, Ibn ʿĀmir, and al-Kisāʾī kasra nūn in nisyan; Ḥamza and Ḥafṣ open it, while Abū Bakr kasras it.
rows.anchor: 7 واختلفوا فى كسر النون وفتحها من قوله ﴿ نسيا منسيا ﴾ 23

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Abū ʿAmr, Ibn ʿĀmir, and Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim open mīm and tāʾ in min taḥtihā; Nāfiʿ, Ḥamza, al-Kisāʾī, and Ḥafṣ kasra both.
rows.anchor: 8 واختلفوا فى فتح الميم والتاء وكسرهما من قوله ﴿ من تحتها ﴾ 24

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No reader uses yāʾ in tasaqqaṭ. Most use fatḥa tāʾ and doubled sīn; Ḥamza lightens sīn; Abū Bakr matches Abū ʿAmr; Ḥafṣ uses ḍamma tāʾ, kasra qāf, and light sīn.
rows.anchor: 9 واختلفوا فى التخفيف والتشديد مع التاء ولم يقرأ أحد منهم بالياء من قوله ﴿ تساقط عليك رطبا جنيا ﴾ 25

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Kisāʾī applies imāla to ātānī and awṣānī; the other readers do not.
rows.anchor: 10 قوله ﴿ آتاني ﴾ 30 ﴿ وأوصاني ﴾ 31

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿĀṣim and Ibn ʿĀmir read qawla al-ḥaqq in the accusative; Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use the nominative.
rows.anchor: 11 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ ذلك عيسى ابن مريم قول الحق ﴾ 34

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn ʿĀmir alone reads kun fa-yakūna in the accusative, which Ibn Mujāhid calls grammatically wrong; the others use nominative.
rows.anchor: 12 قوله ﴿ كن فيكون ﴾ 35

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, and Abū ʿAmr use fatḥa on the hamza in wa-an Allāha; Ibn ʿĀmir, ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use kasra.
rows.anchor: 13 واختلفوا فى فتح الألف وكسرها من قوله ﴿ وإن الله ربي وربكم ﴾ 36

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lām in mukhliṣan is kasra in several transmissions from Ibn Kathīr, Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAmr, Ibn ʿĀmir, and ʿĀṣim; other transmissions from ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use fatḥa.
rows.anchor: 14 واختلفوا فى فتح اللام وكسرها من قوله ﴿ إنه كان مخلصا ﴾ 51

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAlī b. Naṣr reports Abū ʿAmr assimilating lām in hal taʿlam, while allowing either assimilation or clear pronunciation; Hārūn says he later returned to clear pronunciation.
rows.anchor: 15 قوله ﴿ هل تعلم ﴾ 65

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nāfiʿ, ʿĀṣim, and Ibn ʿĀmir use a light, quiescent dhāl in a-wa-lā yadhkuru; Ibn Kathīr, Abū ʿAmr, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī double dhāl and kāf.
rows.anchor: 16 واختلفوا فى قوله ﴿ أولا يذكر الإنسان ﴾ 67

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Kisāʾī alone reads light nunjī from anjaytu; the other readers use the heavy form from najjaytu.
rows.anchor: 17 قوله ﴿ ثم ننجي الذين اتقوا ﴾ 72

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The other readers read nunajjī with the heavy form from najjaytu.
rows.anchor: ﴿ ننجي ﴾ من نجيت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr uses ḍamma mīm in khayra maqāman and fatḥa in the other two phrases; Nāfiʿ and Ibn ʿĀmir use ḍamma in maqāmin amīn only; Abū ʿAmr, Abū Bakr, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī use fatḥa throughout. Ḥafṣ varies at al-Aḥzāb.
rows.anchor: 18 واختلفوا فى الضم والفتح للميم فى قوله ﴿ خير مقاما ﴾ 73 وفى الدخان والأحزاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Abū ʿAmr, ʿĀṣim, Ḥamza, and al-Kisāʾī hamzate warʾiyā; Ibn ʿĀmir omits hamza. Nāfiʿ transmissions differ, with some hamzating and others omitting it.
rows.anchor: 19 واختلفوا فى الهمز وتركه من قوله ﴿ ورئيا ﴾ 74

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Kathīr and Abū ʿAmr open wāw in wuladan except at Nūḥ 71:21, where they use ḍamma wāw and quiescent lām. Nāfiʿ, ʿĀṣim, and Ibn ʿĀmir always open wāw; Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī quiesce lām with ḍamma wāw throughout.
rows.anchor: 20 واختلفوا فى ضم الواو وفتحها من قوله ﴿ وولدا ﴾ 77 فى ستة مواضع فى مريم

rows.speaker: حمزة، الكسائي
rows.claim: Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī use ḍamma wāw and quiescent lām in all the cited Quran forms.
rows.anchor: وقرأ حمزة والكسائى بضم الواو وسكون اللام فى كل القرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In Maryam and al-Shūrā, Ibn Kathīr uses tāʾ in takādu and doubled tāʾ in tatafaṭṭarna; Abū Bakr and Abū ʿAmr use tāʾ and yāʾ in yanfaṭirna. Nāfiʿ and al-Kisāʾī use yāʾ in yakādu and doubled tāʾ in tatafaṭṭarna; transmissions from Ḥafṣ, Ḥamza, and Ibn ʿĀmir vary between these patterns.
rows.anchor: 21 واختلفوا فى الياء والتاء من قوله ﴿ تكاد السماوات يتفطرن منه ﴾ 90 وفى عسق 5 مثله
